# Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct tokenizer & processor configuration

These files are redistributed unmodified from
[Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct)
(© Alibaba Cloud, released under the Apache License 2.0), so that Fizgig's text
encoding and AI captioning work with no network access — the model weights load from
the user's own safetensors file, and these supply the tokenizer, chat template, and
image-processor configuration that transformers requires as loose files.

No weights are included. Snapshot: `ebb281ec70b05090aa6165b016eac8ec08e71b17`.
